subject: research/ambient-exploreonly
professional: a machine-learning researcher in contextual bandits and off-policy learning (epsilon-greedy and epoch-greedy exploration, inverse-propensity and doubly robust estimators, covariate shift); first checks: does the MAP fitting routine actually reach the minimum it claims, is selection on the features ignorable for a correctly specified logistic model (so the unweighted 'biased' fit should already be near-consistent), is the explore-only idea positioned against Epoch-Greedy (Langford and Zhang 2007), which learns only from exploration rounds, and do the headline cells survive a converged solver

evidence.correctness: The pipeline reproduces (rerun of experiments/run.py in a scratch copy: results.txt identical, 3 min 49 s; figure.py regenerates explore_only.svg byte for byte) and the oracle reference is right (closed-form Bayes weights from the World parameters [2.0, 2.242, 0, -5.991] vs the code's [1.998, 2.263, -0.019, -6.002]; closed-form oracle utility 12.52/h vs held-out 12.71 +- 0.58, SE 0.13). But the headline cells are optimizer artifacts. fit_map (src/ambient_exploreonly/core.py:42-60) is the copied 40-step undamped Newton solver flagged in docs/reports/2026-11-22-ambient-fit-map-divergence.md. An independent damped-Newton MAP solver with Armijo backtracking on the exact unclipped objective (scratchpad chk/mysolver.py, chk/mapcheck.py) on the hour-100 fits for both priors, eps 0.002 and 0.02, seeds 0-2 (60 fits): every uninformed 'biased' fit (6/6) is non-converged, objective 47,679 to 774,851 vs a true minimum of 89 to 222 (450x to 3,700x), gradient norm 490 to 4,060, distance from the prior mean 163 to 710 against the bound sqrt(2 J(w0)) = 33 to 39 that any true MAP satisfies. All other 54 fits (explore_only, explore_matched, random_matched, full, and every informed fit) match my solver's objective to the printed digits with gradient < 1e-12. Because the deployed learner acts on the diverged weights, the history (and so which windows count as 'explored') is distorted too. Rerunning the whole experiment with fit_map replaced by my solver (same seeds, 23 min 33 s): uninformed biased 10.63/10.85/11.44/11.95 (README 1.59/-0.15/-13.08/-71.85); uninformed explore_only 4.11/5.13/8.13/10.77 (README 7.53/9.61/11.99/12.25); online uninformed biased learner 9.65/8.48/2.65/-9.82 against explore_only 6.23/6.49/2.30/-9.98 (unchanged). Informed rows and the explore_only online rows are unchanged. So with a converged solver the biased fit beats explore_only at every eps under both priors, and results 1 to 3 reverse.
evidence.completeness: Every listed step runs: 5 tests pass (0.51 s); run.py reproduces results.txt exactly (README says about 10 minutes; 3 min 49 s here); figure.py reproduces the SVG; the README's 44 table cells and the informed-online sentence all match results.txt (scripted parse plus hand check of the online rows, whose escaped pipes broke my parser). Next steps are listed as not done. Nothing stubbed.
evidence.verification: `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests`: 5 passed in 0.51 s. Five mutants with platform/ci/quality_mutate.py: 1 caught (online learner choice swapped), 4 survived: explored = coin (counting greedy windows as explored), decision rule ignoring the others cost, prior gradient centred on 0 instead of w0, and half-step Newton. The tests check finiteness, shapes, determinism and eps 0/1 edge cases; none checks that fit_map reaches a stationary point, the test that would have caught the divergence behind the headline.
evidence.craft: Read src/ambient_exploreonly/core.py (160 lines), experiments/run.py, experiments/figure.py, tests/test_exploreonly.py. Compact and readable, seeds fixed. Defects: fit_map is a copied engine (from ambient-labelmatch and siblings) with no line search and no convergence check, silently returning after 40 iterations (core.py:52-60); the sigmoid clip at +-30 (core.py:39) zeroes the Hessian weight of saturated points, which feeds the divergence; the covariance np.linalg.inv(H) is computed and always discarded; results.txt is written with an unclosed open() (run.py:62).
evidence.claims: Backed: every table cell (matches results.txt), the label counts, 'a quarter of the biased fit's' labels (680/2691, 1555/6430), 'about five needs' in 177 windows (177 x 0.03 = 5.3), the oracle 12.71, the informed-prior statements (result 5) and the exploration-cost trend (result 4), the candid limitations (well-specified model, wake-phrase selection on the outcome). Not backed: the title-level 'Positive result in the uninformed-prior regime' (README.md:3), results 1-3 (README.md:68-70) and the same claim in the homepage summary (research/_homepage/projects.json) and the research/README.md:468 bullet ('fixes the uninformed-prior failure ... 11.99 vs -13.08'). The failure they fix is solver divergence; with a converged solver the biased fit scores 11.44 vs explore_only 8.13 at eps 0.02. The README's own limitation ('choosing windows by features does not bias a logistic fit') should have flagged biased weights 179 to 2,064 from the oracle as impossible.
evidence.fitness: Job: a bandit researcher wants to know whether training only on exploration rounds beats training on all logged rounds when the deployed policy learns from its own feedback. They get a clean, fast, reproducible simulator they can build on, but the answer it gives is reversed by a solver bug, and the idea is not new: Epoch-Greedy (Langford and Zhang, NeurIPS 2007) learns only from exploration steps, and for selection on covariates with a correctly specified model the unweighted MLE is consistent (Shimodaira 2000), so the expected result is that the full spoken set wins except for the wake-phrase selection on the outcome; that is what the converged rerun shows. None of this prior work is cited (README cites only Horvitz 1999 for the decision rule). Cited from memory, not re-checked online here.
evidence.domain: Against standard practice for MAP/logistic fitting (damped or line-searched Newton, IRLS with step halving, or a library solver, plus a convergence check; Boyd and Vandenberghe 2004, sec. 9.5) the solver departs, and against bandit practice (check that the estimator is the one claimed, position against epoch-greedy and covariate-shift theory, test a misspecified model) the study departs too. The simulated world itself (expected-utility rule, noisy-OR wake, d' = 2) is reasonable and the oracle checks analytically. Stylised inputs are disclosed. Well below the research/CLAUDE.md PhD bar.

defects.what: fit_map takes 40 undamped Newton steps with no line search and no convergence check and diverges for the uninformed-prior biased fit: objective 450x to 3,700x the true minimum, weights 163 to 710 from the prior mean where any true MAP is within 33 to 39. The deployed learner acts on these weights, so the logged history is distorted too. Same copied solver as docs/reports/2026-11-22-ambient-fit-map-divergence.md.

Headline reversed by the solver bug: 'Positive result in the uninformed-prior regime' and results 1-3 (explore_only 11.99 vs biased -13.08 at eps 0.02; online 6.49 vs -2.04 at eps 0.005). With a converged solver biased scores 10.63/10.85/11.44/11.95 against explore_only 4.11/5.13/8.13/10.77, and the biased online learner 9.65/8.48/2.65/-9.82 against 6.23/6.49/2.30/-9.98. The same claim is in research/_homepage/projects.json and research/README.md:468.

Core logic untested: 4 of 5 seeded mutants survive (explored set including greedy windows, decision rule ignoring the others cost, prior gradient centred on 0, half Newton step), and no test checks that fit_map is stationary from a poor start.

No nearest prior work: learning only from exploration rounds is Epoch-Greedy (Langford and Zhang 2007), and consistency of an unweighted, correctly specified MLE under selection on covariates is Shimodaira 2000; neither is cited, so novelty is overstated and the expected answer (biased wins except for wake-phrase selection on the outcome) is not tested against.
README runtime 'about 10 minutes' is 3 min 49 s here; sigmoid clip at +-30 zeroes saturated Hessian terms; inv(H) computed and discarded; unclosed file handle in run.py:62.

verdict: Reproducible and tidy (run.py and the figure reproduce exactly, the oracle checks against a closed-form Bayes computation), but the headline is an optimizer artifact. The copied undamped Newton solver diverges on every uninformed-prior biased fit checked (objective up to 3,700x the minimum), and with an independent line-searched solver the result reverses: the biased fit beats explore-only at every eps under both priors (11.44 vs 8.13 at eps 0.02), offline and online. The informed-prior result and the exploration-cost trend stand. Tests miss 4 of 5 seeded bugs and the nearest prior work (Epoch-Greedy, covariate-shift theory) is not cited. Does not meet the bar.
